coverage: Named roster 5 of 5 fetched raw and read in full: Kirk et al. ICLR 2024, Zhang et al. Verbalized Sampling, Lanchantin et al. Diverse Preference Optimization, Sharma et al. sycophancy, Shumailov et al. Nature — the last only after correcting the DOI, since nature.com/articles/s41586-024-07566-6 is a 404 and the paper is -07566-y, read from the Edinburgh publisher version-of-record PDF. None blocked outright; two secondary fetches needed the Wayback raw route (LessWrong behind a Vercel checkpoint, OpenReview serving an HTML shell) and two vendor pages (openai.com GPT-4.5 index, anthropic.com news) returned an empty shell and a 404 and are logged as not found. 20 substantive sources: 5 roster, 12 by bibliography chasing through the Verbalized Sampling, DivPO and West-and-Potts reference lists, 2 by OpenAlex lateral search (the ICCC 2024 temperature study and the WikiNLP Wikipedia measurement), 1 by OpenReview title search. WebSearch budget for the session was exhausted after one query, so open-web lateral search was replaced by the OpenAlex, Crossref and OpenReview APIs; two consecutive OpenAlex probes returned nothing new. WebFetch was rejected as a read route throughout because it returned summaries rather than page text; every source was read by curl with a browser user agent plus pypdf extraction. The archival or encyclopedic register remains almost unmeasured: the only two touches are Shumailov et al. fine-tuning OPT-125m on wikitext2 and the Princeton WikiNLP detection study, and neither measures prose quality or register in that voice.
